data.name: Rukayyah
data.gender_notes: Rukayyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rukayyah is the name of the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and Khadija (may Allah be pleased with her). The name Rukayyah carries the meaning “Companion of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rukayyah usually hope their child will grow to embody companion of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of love, compassion, and companionship.
data.etymology: Rukayyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion of the Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rukayyah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: رقيّة
in_arabic.long_meaning: رقيّة هي اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل رقي الذي يعني العلاج والرعاية، وتعكس概念 العناية الإلهية والرحمة في الإسلام، كما تظهر في التاريخ الإسلامي كاسم لابنة النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

in_urdu.name: رقیہ
in_urdu.meaning: رقیہ کا مطلب علاج اور دیکھ بھال
in_urdu.long_meaning: رقیہ ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو عربی لفظ رقی سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے علاج اور دیکھ بھال، یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں رحم و شفقت کے تصور کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: रुकैया
in_hindi.meaning: रुकैया का अर्थ उपचार और देखभाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: रुकैया एक इस्लामिक नाम है जो अरबी शब्द रुकी से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है उपचार और देखभाल, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में दया और करुणा की अवधारणा को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: رقيہ

in_english.name: Rukayyah
in_english.long_meaning: Rukayyah is an Islamic name derived from the Arabic root r-q-y, meaning treatment and care, reflecting the concept of divine care and mercy in Islam, as seen in Islamic tradition and history

data.cultural_impact: Rukayyah is considered an important figure in Islamic history as she is believed to be the first grandchild of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Her name has been passed down through generations, making it a common name amongst Muslims. additionally, she is renowned for her strong faith and dedication to Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: Rukayyah's name holds deep spiritual significance as she is believed to have a close relationship with Allah. Her name is mentioned in Hadith (sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad) as an example of piety and devotion. Rukayyah's story serves as an inspiration for Muslims to strive for a strong faith and to cultivate good character. The name Rukayyah is a reminder of the importance of family and the blessings that come from being close to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
